d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

We are seeking an experienced and self-driven Senior KOL Relations Specialist to join our team. This is a high-impact opportunity for a seasoned PR professional who can hit the ground running — building and managing KOL relationships, leading event activations, and navigating communications in the fast-paced crypto industry.

In this role, you will take ownership of KOL partnerships end-to-end — from identifying and engaging high-impact influencers to leading event coordination and managing sensitive communications with composure. As a key representative of our brand, you will ensure smooth collaboration and maintain strong public perception across KOL-facing initiatives.
If you are a proactive, confident communicator with a proven track record in influencer relations and a readiness to contribute from day one, we would love to hear from you!
q: Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in KOL/influencer relations, PR, or partnerships, preferably within tech, fintech, or consumer brands.
Proven track record of independently managing KOL portfolios from sourcing to activation — able to hit the ground running with minimal onboarding.
Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with confidence in engaging high-profile individuals and managing sensitive conversations.
Polished, presentable, and comfortable representing the brand at external events and on-camera engagements.
Strong crisis management instincts — able to navigate sensitive situations with composure and sound judgment.
Proactive, detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment.
Knowledge of or interest in crypto/blockchain is a plus but not mandatory.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
